name: omengram
author: gudetimes
description: Spaced-repetition flashcards in the bar, with your Anki collection

barWidget.description: Review flashcards without leaving the bar

schema.label: Deck library
schema.description: Directory of deck files. Leave empty for ~/.local/share/omengram.

schema.label: Deck file
schema.description: Study this one file instead of the library. Leave empty for the library.

schema.label: New cards per day
schema.description: How many unseen cards to introduce per study day. 0 reviews only.

schema.label: Review cap per day
schema.description: Cap how many due cards a day serves. 0 means no cap. Cards introduced today do not count against it.

schema.label: Show waiting count
schema.description: Show the number of waiting cards next to the bar glyph.

schema.label: Target retention
schema.description: The share of reviews FSRS schedules you to pass, as a percentage. Higher means shorter gaps and more reviews. Library cards only; Anki's cards follow Anki's deck options.

schema.label: Drills in the bar panel
schema.description: Show drill cards in the bar panel too, answered from memory. Off leaves them to the overlay, where they are typed, run and line-drilled.

schema.label: Leech threshold
schema.description: How many times a card may be forgotten before it counts as a leech. 0 turns leeches off.

schema.label: Suspend leeches
schema.description: Take a leech out of the rotation rather than only marking it. Restore them from the statistics view.

schema.label: Study Anki's collection
schema.description: Show your Anki decks beside the library and grade them on Anki's own schedule, so reviews reach AnkiWeb and your phone.

schema.label: Anki profile
schema.description: Which Anki profile to use. Leave empty for the only one there is.

schema.label: Sync every (minutes)
schema.description: How often the bar syncs with AnkiWeb, after a first sync shortly after login. 0 syncs only when asked.
